description: Every poe.ninja price, offline, searchable, and scriptable — with arbitrage math no browser tab can do.

novel_features.name: Arbitrage Chain Finder
novel_features.description: Find profitable multi-hop currency trading cycles using graph math over all exchange rates simultaneously.

novel_features.name: Bulk Flip Optimizer
novel_features.description: Given a chaos budget, find the single most profitable currency-to-currency round-trip trade accounting for bulk minimums.

novel_features.name: Supply Shock Detector
novel_features.description: Find items where supply is drying up (listing count dropped) before price has reacted — the leading edge of a price spike.

novel_features.name: Liquid Net Worth Calculator
novel_features.description: Calculate total chaos value of a user-supplied inventory, flagging illiquid holdings (low listing count) vs. paper wealth.

novel_features.name: Economy Velocity Dashboard
novel_features.description: Rank item categories by price acceleration computed from 7-day sparkline data across the entire database.

novel_features.name: Div Card Value Decoder
novel_features.description: Show all divination cards sorted by profit from completing a set vs. selling individual cards, using cross-table price joins.

novel_features.name: ASCII Sparkline Trend Viewer
novel_features.description: Render 7-day price history for any currency or item as an ASCII chart directly in the terminal.

novel_features.name: Portfolio Value Tracker
novel_features.description: Track a user-defined list of currencies and items by total chaos value, updated each sync.

novel_features.name: Cross-League Price Comparison
novel_features.description: Show the price of the same item side-by-side in two leagues to identify value arbitrage opportunities.
